parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of StrPrinter settings being ignored by certain subexpressions, but it may introduce behavioral regressions and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The patch may break existing behavior by changing how certain expressions are printed, potentially affecting other parts of the codebase that rely on the current printing behavior.
The PR does not include any new tests to verify that the changes do not introduce regressions or that the issue is fully resolved across all relevant cases.
